scope: Complete construction, pressure testing and acceptance of one explicitly designed pressure-sewer pipeline: 800 m of selected HDPE PE100-RC SDR17 OD 110 PN10 pipe. Pipe-system materials, trench quantities, valves, air-release and washout assemblies, chambers, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved wastewater design organization, geotechnical engineer, pressure-pipe manufacturer, construction laboratory and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved pipe material, grade, SDR, diameter and pressure-class schedule
approved trench, bedding, surround, backfill and excess-soil quantities
approved joints, fittings, isolation valves, air-release, washout and chamber schedule
installation and jointing method with labor and mechanism quantities
conditional crossing-casing, dewatering and road-restoration schedules
supplier pipe-segment length and approved retained spare length

rules.totalNeed: installed net length + retained spare length

forbiddenClaims: trench or material quantities derived from generic length coefficients
automatic manhole, connection-node, valve, air-release or washout spacing
automatic casing, dewatering or road restoration
universal pipe spare or supplier segment length
pumping station, gravity collector or building drainage included
